text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iraqi pilgrims who left by bus for the haj have entered Saudi territory.
- Iraq protests to the Arab League against American, British and French warplanes' violation of Iraqi air space.
- Moscow rejects recent U.S. officials' statements on Iraq.
- Deputy Prime Minister Tareq Aziz meets with Arab political delegations attending 50th anniversary of the Arab Baath Party.
- National Assembly condemns Israeli policies in occupied Arab territory.
- Egyptian firms organise medical fair in Baghdad.
(The above were also carried by THAWRA and JUMHOURIYA)
- Minister of industry and minerals Adnan Abdul-Majeed Jassim meets with head of the French interest section in Baghdad.
